summary: Short kerb at a junction mouth, steep, with a house beside it.
reasons: Junction mouth, little room to stop

drivers.seclusion: Houses (4 m and 13 m) sit right on the kerb; the rest is a junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 19 m of kerb at an intersection with painted islands and crossing; no clear room.
drivers.traffic: Junction of several streets, with turning traffic.
drivers.convention: No parked cars at this spot.

flags: House within 10 m of the kerb (imagery shows the building as a home)
Mapped gate 48 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Open to sun; the house shades the west side in the morning.
